activity_summary: At home the tables show the line you wrote in the parlour, Edith viij s. owing. Lady Day. It is not your debt. It is not paid. You did not set a coffer total next to it, and you did not open an expected column.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept the line, and did not strike it.

entities.context: Named on the tables. Not in the room.
